entities.name: Olvresk
entities.description: Keldon doyen responsible for honing Astor into a powerful warlord.

entities.name: Astor
entities.description: Former camp runner trained by Tajamin and Olvresk who became warlord of Keld.

entities.name: Treulk
entities.description: Commander for whom Astor was camp runner.

entities.name: Tajamin
entities.description: Keeper of the Book of Keld who trained Astor.

entities.name: Kradak
entities.description: Keld's first warlord, who appeared to Astor in a vision.

events.summary: Olvresk takes Astor from Treulk and sends him to train under Tajamin.
events.quote: Olvresk took him from Treulk and sent Astor to train under Doyenne Tajamin

events.summary: Olvresk stormed Tajamin's compound with his Fists and slaughtered many; Tajamin saves herself and Astor by proposing Olvresk teach the Tinder Spell.
events.quote: He stormed Tajamin's compound and used his Fists, his elite soldiers, to slaughter many of Tajamin's people.

events.summary: Astor learns the spell in two days without food; Tajamin tells him of Jezal's Covenant.
events.quote: Two days later, Astor knew the spell

events.summary: Astor slays a Colos on the Mountain and fights off wolves.
events.quote: Astor fought them off before continuing further up the mountain.

events.summary: At the peak Astor sees a vision of Kradak, who warns of the Keldon Twilight, and becomes a warlord.
events.quote: Kradak warned Astor of the coming of the Keldon Twilight in Astor's lifetime.

relations.quote: Olvresk was a Keldon doyen who was responsible for honing Astor into a powerful warlord.
train under Doyenne Tajamin , the Keeper of the Book of Keld

relations.note: disagreed with her methods and attacked her compound
relations.quote: Olvresk disagreed strongly with these methods.
